n9919412d7b.headline: Exchange raises over N4.7 trillion through fixed income in H1
n9919412d7b.summary: The Nigerian Exchange Limited reported raising more than N4.7 trillion in fixed income securities during the first half of the year, including a N25 billion listing by Coronation Merchant Bank Funding SPV Plc.
n9919412d7b.why: The Nigerian Exchange is a key financial market platform in Nigeria, and fixed income fundraising reflects government and corporate financing activity important for investors and the economy.
